title: Creative Coding
blurb: Motion and image made from code alone. Watch the output, then open the source behind it.

works.title: Arrivals
works.desc: Type that never simply appears: every word arrives by its own mechanic, and how it arrives is the message.
about: A typographic motion piece rendered entirely in code, in five beats. Each beat performs a different arrival mechanic: hairline rule grids that draw and retract, bars that slam in, grain-edged sweeps, slit rows, vertical blinds, and rotated outlines that converge like moire.

Kinetic-type techniques carry the words themselves: tracking collapse, per-letter rise with overshoot, glyph scramble, motion-blur slides, flash exposure, noise dissolve and slice glitch. It keeps strictly to the brand system, with a void ground, bone type, silver and ash rules, and Cormorant Garamond, Jost and JetBrains Mono.

works.title: Oracle
works.desc: A halftone portrait holds a scrying orb over black water that ripples with every heartbeat.
about: A portrait re-printed as a fixed stipple dither, so the dots stay put while light moves through them. The black water in front of her is a real wave simulation: pulses from the orb bend a mirrored copy of the portrait and catch the orb light as concentric glints.

The orb is an RGB dot-matrix lens holding refracted smoke, a miniature sigil and her magnified face, ringed by chromatic flare chains. Every loop is built from periodic motions, so the four second clip repeats without a seam.

works.title: Scrying Basin
works.desc: A crystal sphere pulses over a basin of black oil, and the ripples bend a rotating ceiling of sigils.
about: A generative occult motion piece written in pure NumPy and SciPy, with no image or video assets. Each time the sphere pulses it sends ripples across the oil, and the oil mirrors a rotating ceiling of sigils, a rune ring, a hexagram and star nodes. The ripples bend that reflection.

The sphere itself is a halftone RGB dot-matrix lens holding a miniature of the same sigil, ringed by chains of chromatic flares. Every motion is built from 6, 12, 36 or 180 fold symmetries, so the six second clip loops without a seam.

works.title: Nodal Descent
works.desc: Pulses cross a dark plane and show only where the crests catch a low, raking light.
about: A wave simulation rendered as raking light. Ricker pulses are injected at the centre cell on an uneven schedule, and a damped leapfrog solver sends the ripples outward across a grid with absorbing edges.

The render never feeds back into the solver. Surface normals come from the height gradient, cast shadows from twelve height samples toward a low light, and a fixed grain texture lights up only where a crest catches that light. Three warm-up cycles bring the five second loop to a near periodic steady state.
